notes.title: New Melee Skill support
notes.content:
Small update tonight:

Added a new Lightning Melee tagged support: [b]Capacitor Discharging[/b]

[i]Hitting a Jolted Enemy has a 50% Chance to cause a bolt of Lightning to strike up to 3 nearby enemies, consuming the Jolt. Damage inflicted by Lightning deals damage equal to the initial Hit Damage multiplied by 200% of the Jolt on the original enemy. Lightning can Critically Strike, but it cannot inflict Ailments.[/i]

Also doubled the base radius of all Curse skills at max level.

Also fixed a timing bug with a couple melee abilities.

Currently working on a bunch of new skill supports, as well as some uniques to give new build potential.

Cheers!
zediven

notes.title: Mutagenic 0.6.0
notes.content:
Good afternoon!

It's been a while since I've had an update here -- I apologize. I have had this patch nearly ready for a few months, but I have been busy with life and it got put on the back burner (I was hoping to have this out in February).

Today I'm releasing Mutagenic 0.6.0 which contains a complete overhaul to the equipment system in game, adding much more flexibility and build diversity. As well, there are a number of new skills, a brand new passive tree, and character classes (with free respec).

I'll note the major changes below, but I won't list out all of the specifics as frankly I don't have enough time and there are way too many changes under the hood.

[b]Major Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] 4 Character classes
[*] 2 Specialization Classes per Character Class
[*] New Itemization system, including various new drop only mods, item implicit mods, and more.
[*] New skills & skill supports
[*] New Passive Tree
[*] UI Overhaul
[*] Character Save Slots
[*] Item Stash Transfer between your Characters
[*] Many updates regarding performance, UX, etc. In all honesty -- I can't remember every change, but there are a lot!
[/list]

This is all an advancement towards my end vision, and I hope you enjoy the update. As always, please let me know of any issues you encounter.

Cheers!
zediven


Please note: I have not fully tested this update on my Steam deck yet, so expect some issues if you try it.

notes.title: Hotfix 0.5.5.3
notes.content:
Hey all,

One last update before I'm away for a few days.

Just deployed a hotfix to the game fixing the random crashing people were experience.

The actual bug was complicated, but here's the TLDR:

I left in one line of debugging code which caused low level items to "try to roll" drop-only affixes, with a 50% chance. This meant if you were playing in a zone under level 80, then when an item dropped, it had a 50% chance to crash the game.

This has been fixed.



Cheers,
zediven

Build ID: 12663486 to check you are running the hotfix.

notes.title: Early Access 0.5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

OK, I admit it has been a long time since a major update, and I apologize for that.

Having said that, I'm excited to finally have Early Access patch 0.5 out in the wild!

The following are patch notes for the patch overhaul:


[b]High Level Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Various new Weapon, Curse, and Aura Skills, including unlockable customization system
[*]Vastly expanded and modified Passive Tree
[*]Customizable Character Outfits
[*]Numerous new mod types, attributes, and skill mechanics
[*]Performance Optimizations Galore
[*]World map progression system
[*]Support for boss fights & arenas
[*]New ladder/leaderboard system
[*]Powerful, drop-only endgame mods
[*]Magic and Rare monster mods
[*]Player Damage Log
[*]Complete rebalance of monster and player power
[/list]


[b]New Skills[/b]

This patch introduces a couple of new skills, which can all be augmented with Skill Supports listed in a later section. New skills will be added in upcoming patches.

[list]
[*]Minigun: Rapid fire weapon.
[*]Icy Shard Burst: Cast a volatile ball of ice at a nearby enemy, which releases shards in random directions. Extra projectiles affect the number of released shards. Shards cannot pierce or chain.
[*]Scorch Curse: Curse enemies in an area with Scorch, lowering their Fire Resistance by 25%.
[*]Hypothermia Curse: Curse enemies in an area with Hyptothermia, lowering their Cold Resistance by 25%.
[*]Polarize Curse: Curse enemies in an area with Polarize, lowering their Lightning Resistance by 25%.
[*]Bane Curse: Curse enemies in an area with Bane, lowering their Toxic Resistance by 25%.
[*]Rush Aura: You and nearby allies move faster.
[*]Regeneration Aura: You and nearby allies have added life regeneration.
[*]Resilience Aura: You and nearby allies have a chance to avoid ailments.
[/list]

Example of Icy Shard Burst on a low level character:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42713275/71995d824a8df66dd9353308c996780a5e2fd550.jpg[/img]

[b]Skill Supports[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42713275/5f5aa9bcf823db11507ef52c000cc3a90d49527c.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Extra Projectiles[/b]: Skill fires 2 extra projectiles, but deals 30% Less Damage.
[*] [b]Sniper[/b]: Projectiles have no spread.
[*] [b]Collateral Damage[/b]: Projectiles deal 30% of hit damage to nearby enemies.
[*] [b]Puncturing Shots[/b]: Projectiles gain +3 Pierce.
[*] [b]Ricocheting Shots[/b]: Projectiles gain +2 Chain, but deal 30% Less Damage.
[*] [b]Quicker Projectiles[/b]: Projectiles gain 30% More Projectile Speed.
[*] [b]Focus[/b]: Skill deals 50% More Damage, but will never Critically Strike.
[*] [b]Critical Honing[/b]: Skill gains +1.5% Base Critical Strike Chance, and has 125% Increased Critical Strike Chance.
[*] [b]Critical Mass[/b]: Skill gains 100% Critical Strike Multiplier.
[*] [b]Bloody[/b]: Skill gains +25% Physical Ailment Chance, and 15% More Physical Ailment Effect.
[*] [b]Ignition[/b]: Skill gains +25% Fire Ailment Chance, and 15% More Fire Ailment Effect.
[*] [b]Chilling[/b]: Skill gains +25% Cold Ailment Chance, and 15% More Cold Ailment Effect.
[*] [b]Charged[/b]: Skill gains +25% Lightning Ailment Chance, and 15% More Lightning Ailment Effect.
[*] [b]Poison[/b]: Skill gains +25% Toxic Ailment Chance, and 15% More Toxic Ailment Effect.
[*] [b]Lacerating[/b]: Skill gains 50% Increased Physical Ailment Effect.
[*] [b]Stunner[/b]: Skill gains 50% Increased Lightning Ailment Effect.
[*] [b]Frigid[/b]: Skill gains 50% Increased Cold Ailment Effect.
[*] [b]Scorched[/b]: Skill gains 50% Increased Fire Ailment Effect.
[*] [b]Venom[/b]: Skill gains 50% Increased Toxic Ailment Effect.
[*] [b]Wizardry[/b]: Skill gains 40% More Cast Speed.
[*] [b]Cold Attuned[/b]: Skill gains 50% Physical Damage Converted to Cold Damage.
[*] [b]Shock Attuned[/b]: Skill gains 50% Physical Damage Converted to Lightning Damage.
[*] [b]Fire Attuned[/b]: Skill gains 50% Physical Damage Converted to Fire Damage.
[*] [b]Expansive[/b]: Skill gains 50% Increased Area of Effect, and 25% More Area Damage.
[*] [b]Physical Damage[/b]: Skill gains 40% More Physical Damage.
[*] [b]Lightning Damage[/b]: Skill gains 40% More Lightning Damage.
[*] [b]Cold Damage[/b]: Skill gains 40% More Cold Damage.
[*] [b]Fire Damage[/b]: Skill gains 40% More Fire Damage.
[*] [b]Toxic Damage[/b]: Skill gains 40% More Toxic Damage.
[*] [b]Physical Penetration[/b]: Skill gains 25% Physical Penetration.
[*] [b]Lightning Penetration[/b]: Skill gains 25% Lightning Penetration.
[*] [b]Cold Penetration[/b]: Skill gains 25% Cold Penetration.
[*] [b]Fire Penetration[/b]: Skill gains 25% Fire Penetration.
[*] [b]Toxic Penetration[/b]: Skill gains 25% Toxic Penetration.
[*] [b]Ailment Duration[/b]: Skill gains 50% Increased Ailment Duration.
[*] [b]Enhanced Ailments[/b]: Skill gains 50% Chance to inflict Enhanced Ailments.
[*] [b]Increased Duration[/b]: Skill gains 50% Increased Skill Duration
[*] [b]Potent Suppression[/b]: Skill gains 30% More Damage over Time
[*] [b]Vulnerability[/b]: Skill gains 30% Chance to Inflict Vulnerable on Hit, and has inflicts Vulnerable with 25% Increased Vulnerable Effect.
[*] [b]Weakness[/b]: Skill gains 30% Chance to Inflict Exposure on Hit, and has inflicts Exposure with 25% Increased Exposure Effect.
[*] [b]Doomed[/b]: Skill gains 20% More Curse Effect.
[*] [b]Large Curses[/b]: Skill gains 50% Increased Area of Effect with Curse Skills.
[*] [b]Infection[/b]: Skill gains +1 Infection Spread Count
[*] [b]Cast on Crit[/b]: Skill is cast when another skill inflicts a critical strike. Skill does not auto cast, and cannot trigger other skills.
[*] [b]Cast on Crit[/b]: Skill is cast when another skill inflicts a critical strike. Skill does not auto cast, and cannot trigger other skills. Skill deals 40% Less Damage.
[*] [b]Cast on Kill[/b]: Skill has a 10% chance to cast when another skill inflicts a killing blow. Skill does not auto cast, and cannot trigger other skills. Skill deals 30% More Damage.
[*] [b]Volatility[/b]: Skill is cast when hitting an enemy with any non-triggered skill. Skill consumes a random number of Boons to deal 20% more damage for each consumed Boon. Must have at least one active boon to cast. Skill does not auto cast, and cannot trigger other skills. Skill deals 15% Less Damage.
[*] [b]Precision Boon on Critical Strike[/b]: Skill has a 40% Chance to gain a Precision Boon when it Critically Strikes.
[/list]

More Skill Supports are planned for upcoming patches.

[b]Cosmetics[/b]

I've introduced support to customize the look of your character!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42713275/597f4ef223cdc7d1f79a3613068f56bb43022e7c.jpg[/img]

[b]Passive Tree[/b]

A complete rebalance of the Passive Tree, and an expansion of it as well!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42713275/54b0734aa20ce7c3b0a55cf15815de4381ed6ebd.jpg[/img]

[b]Gene Drop Improvements[/b]

Genes drop from enemies, and have a high chance of having at least one max-tier roll on them. In high tier zones (80+), new Drop-Only mods can roll on items, enabling further build varieties!

Low Tier Gene Drop:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42713275/b9bdf5a4106a74b94a4098fe9228b654bf1ef980.jpg[/img]

[b]Monster Changes[/b]

Monsters can now randomly spawn as a Magic Pack or with a Rare Monster, which are tougher enemies but provide more experience and higher chance of good loot!

A rare monster and some magic monsters:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42713275/42ade4a03421fce783b2e1bc602ca1128e794095.jpg[/img]


[b]New Stat Options[/b]

Alongside the changes to the skill system, I've introduced various new ways to scale damage and defenses. There are now 5 attributes on the Passive Tree, and as mods on items:

[list]
[*][b]Constitution[/b]: Grants 1 Maximum Life per Constitution
[*][b]Strength[/b]: Grants 1% Increased Armor per Strength
[*][b]Agility[/b]:  Grants 1% Increased Evasion per Agility
[*][b]Wisdom[/b]: Grants 1% Increased Damage per 5 Wisdom
[*][b]Finesse[/b]: Grants 1% Increased Cast Speed per 5 Finesse
[/list]

As well as the innate bonuses these stats provide, there are mods that let you use them as your main method to scale damage! Check out the mods in-game to see.

[b]Boons[/b]

I've also introduced a Boon system to Mutagenic, which are temporary buffs which grant offensive and defensive power to your character. There are multiple ways to get these Boons, and ways to scale both offense and defense with them. There are some drop-only mods which interact with these in powerful ways.


[b]Summary[/b]

This patch introduces a lot of change to Mutagenic. The game is vastly different that it was before, and I apologize if this is an unwanted change for some. I'm considering keeping the old version on a beta-only branch if there is demand. I promise this version will be much better, and I intend on improving it in the coming months.

Thank you, and good luck!

If anybody is interested in writing/theorycrafting some build guides for new players, please do so!

Cheers,
zediven

notes.title: Patch 0.4.5 - Major Update, Crafting, Gene System, New Characters & Skills
notes.content:
Patch 0.4.5 is finally here!


A short list of the changes (there are a LOT more than this):

[olist]
[*] Hi resolution UI
[*] Gene System (Persistent Character Equipment)
[*] Powerful Gene Crafting System
[*] Expanded Mutation Tree
[*] Dozens of new Character Stats
[*] New Characters
[*] New Skills
[*] Codex revamp -- look up all stats of items
[*] Crafting reference
[*] Complete Balance overhaul
[*] Much deeper combat mechanics
[*] New enemies & enemy skills
[*] Full Controller Support
[*] Removal of old Customize Items in favor of Gene System
[*] Many, many, bugfixes and QoL improvements.
[/olist]

Most importantly, this patch lays the groundwork for the future. With the core systems now in place, future patches will be focusing on content expansion.

[b]Expanded Combat & Enemies[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42713275/13e6375b6ffa7f38f85bc7d1c79663b1801341f4.png[/img]

Genes are craftable items which you equip in a Gene Loadout. Gene Loadouts are usable by any of your characters, providing them with powerful stat boosts and mechanical changes!

There are 4 types of Genes: Offensive, Defensive, Utility, and Lesser. Unique variants of these are coming in an upcoming patch. Each one has different possible mods, and different mod strength. Check the in-game reference specific details.

[b]Gene Loadouts[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42713275/12d66b3bbeb795a81e6c82907b68dd1681838e8e.jpg[/img]

Upcoming patches will introduce more Unique Gene varieties, introducing even more build diversity on top of the massive amount already introduced in this iniital launch!

[b]The Gene Editor[/b]

The new Gene Editor lets you craft your own unique, powerful Genes for use with your characters. Many powerful combinations can be crafted through skill and a bit of luck!

All crafting is powered by the various orb drops from enemies -- check it out in game to experiment!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42713275/cbe47fb80a5f9341c82e560f3826896b394ccf21.jpg[/img]

[b]New Mutation Tree[/b]

An expanded, rebalance Mutation Tree, with adding Quality of Life features such as smart pathing, full controller support, renaming, and more.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42713275/6489f9d4770dd0582c68fbc73fcaa07cce6fa5f2.jpg[/img]

[b]Revamped Codex & Reference[/b]

Look up all item stats for every tier, and every possible crafting outcome. Plan your crafts, execute, and become a Mutagenic hero!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42713275/23de6e0a89946c225b16b87ec7fb4ad80114832d.jpg[/img]

... and much more to come!


Many thanks to the people who helped test out the beta (you know you are)-- your contributions are greatly appreciated!


Remember to check out the official [url=https://discord.gg/TzF3aRWnhZ]Discord server[/url] for build ideas and chat!

Cheers!
zediven

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
Good morning!

Today I'm releasing update 0.4.3

This update reintroduces macOS support!

Among two 2 skills, and a few new items, this update brings many improvements to the user interface, as well as some big balance changes and bugfixes.

Here are some of the changes:

======

Steam Achievements!

I've added in support for Steam Achievements in this update, and will continue to add more with further updates.

======
2 New Active Skills: Static Charge and Pompeii

Static Charge creates orbs of lightning damage which move around the character damaging enemies.

Pompeii summons a small volcano which periodically shoots Fire projectiles, dealing area damage.

======

5 New Essence Items which give your character more penetration stats.

======

A few new status effects: [b]Charred, Conductive, Exposed[/b]

Fire damage has a 10% chance on hit to inflict Charred, reducing enemy attack and cast speed by 20% for 4 seconds

Lightning damage has a 10% chance on hit to inflict Conductive, increasing damage taken by 10% for 4 seconds.

Exposed is a new status effect that lowers resistances by 10% for 4 seconds. Currently available on the Mutation Tree

======

XP is gained on kill now -- no more annoying orb pickups!

The absorb drop is also gone as a result.

======

Fixed map rotation

Map rotation is now fixed, and cycles through the levels.

======

Poison and Bleed damage types are gone -- these are now considered Physical and Toxic damage.

======

Improved visual clarity of Mutation Tree

Better colors, highlights, and indicators of what is clickable.

======


This was a big change, so I'm naturally worried a bit about stability. Hoping it goes well, but I would appreciate bug reports!

Cheers,
zediven

notes.title: Patch Notes - Windows Only
notes.content:
Good day!

I apologize for the time between the latest update and now.

This patch contains a ton of new features, quality of life improvements, and game system changes. Although this patch doesn't introduce too many new assets, it does introduce very big changes to the underlying mechanics -- the goal is this will allow for much more impactful changes in the future, and I'm excited to start working on them!

A reminder to join the official Discord for latest updates: https://discord.com/invite/TzF3aRWnhZ

High level feature changes:

1. Mutation Tree:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42713275/37de0370c78bf703735f4e3667ca5c58fa2489c4.png[/img]

The new Mutation Tree replaces the old Mutation system, which allows for much greater character customization and more functionality improvements. If you've every played a popular ARPG with one of these, you'll understand :)

Mutation Points are unlocked by leveling up your Mutation Tier, which is accomplished by completing stages. The further you get in a run, the more bonus experience you'll receive. 

2. The game now features stages, instead of a singular level with infinite monsters. As you progress through each stage, you'll gain a portal to the next one, featuring tougher enemies. Leaderboards are now computed on the highest stage completed in the shortest time. Good luck!

3. Damage Types

I've completely overhauled the gameplay mechanics, and there are now multiple different damage types. You can access various stats via the Mutation Tree or via items which allow you to customize your characters!

4. Character Keystones

Each character starts with a unique keystone, giving them each unique gameplay opportunities.

5. Fixed layout generation

Still a work in progress, but level layout generation is much more predictable now.

6. Physics & Knockback

Characters and monsters are now physically simulated, so they can be knocked back, slowed, etc via mechanics in game.

7. Projectiles have a maximum travel distance

8. Many UI improvements, full controller support.

... and much more.

Please note that due to the many many changes in game, this patch will use a new save file. 0.3.x saves are not being deleted, but they will be unused going forward.

I'm very much looking for feedback with this patch, and if you have any suggestions, this is the time!

I'll leave the rest for you to check out in game!

Happy leaderboard chasing!

zediven

Patch Notes 0.3.3

Leaderboards have been reset for the new patch!

[b]General Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Removed mutation warning about losing on death.
[*]Fixed vulnerability not applying properly.
[*]Added vulnerability icon to mob status bar.
[*]Reworked internals of stat calculations to allow more flexibility in keystones.

[/list]
[b]Buffs & Nerfs[/b]
[list]
[*]Vulnerable damage bonus decreased: 140% -> 40%
[*]Growing Pain Area of Effect bonus increased: 20% -> 30%
[*]Spiked Armor damage bonus reduced: 50% -> 20%
[*]Cycle of Destruction changed: damage bonus increased 20% -> 40%, area of effect bonus decreased 100% -> 75%
[*]Plague Clouds base damage buffed by ~100%
[*]Nerfed per-level implant stats: movement speed, projectile speed, cast speed, duration, area of effect.
[/list]
[b]New Keystones[/b]

[b]Infectious Malignancy[/b]: Curses have 20% less effect. Curses on enemies are spread to the a random nearby enemy when they are killed

[b]Curse Fragility[/b]: Curses have 50% less duration, but have 30% increased effect.

[b]Marked for Death[/b]: Enemies take 10% more damage for each curse affecting them.

[b]Chaotic Physics[/b]: Projectiles have a 50% chance to spiral outwards around the player.

[b]Damage Capacitor[/b]: Damage over Time does not deal damage, but instead stores damage as 
potential energy on the enemy. When the enemy is killed, this stored damage is released in a large explosion around the enemy.

[b]Phantom Veil[/b]:Every 3 seconds, gain a Phantom Shield up to a maximum of 2. When you are hit, lose a Phantom Shield, but take no damage. Phantom Shields cannot block Damage over Time.

[b]Leecher[/b]: Recover 1% of Maximum Health when you kill an enemy.

Please let me know if you find any issues!

Cheers,
zediven

notes.title: Early Access release 0.3: Implants & Player Agency improvements
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Today is the release of [b]Early Access major version 0.3[/b]

This update has many exciting changes, vastly [b]improving player agency[/b], including a [b]complete revamp to item upgrades[/b], [b]build diversity[/b], as well as many [b]QoL improvements[/b].

[b]Overview[/b]
[list]
[*] Complete redo of Implants.[b] Implants no longer drop as items, but are configured via the Item menu[/b]. This system is outlined in detail below.
[*] Many new Unique Modifiers (Keystones) for each item. [b]Every item now has at least 2 Unique Modifiers[/b] available to them.
[*] New Buff Bar, [b]showing active effects on your character[/b].
[*] New currency drops, [b]used for upgrading your items[/b].
[*] Changes to the way armor functions (better defense with higher investment)
[*] Many minor UI improvements
[*] Many tweaks to player power curves, player experience curves, item drop curves.
[*] Removed the infinite stacking player damage buff.
[*] Reworked the power levels and costs of almost all mutations.
[*] Much more I’m forgetting.
[/list]

[b]Armor Changes[/b]
[code][b]OLD[/b]: Armor provides 50% less damage taken per 18 armor, capped at [b]87.5% reduced damage taken[/b]. This is reached at 54 armor.[/code] [code][b]NEW[/b]: Armor provides 50% less damage taken per 100 armor, capped at [b]97% reduced damage taken[/b]. This is reached at 500 armor.[/code]

[b]Keystones[/b]

The following is a list of the current keystones available as mods.

[b]Shuriken[/b]

Sanguine Decay
[i]Bleeding enemies explode on death, dealing 5% of the remaining total bleed damage on them to nearby enemies.[/i]

Ricochet
[i]Shuriken deals 20% more damage each time it chains[/i]

[b]Poison Darts[/b]

Impending Contagion
[i]Poisons applied to enemies also apply to nearby enemies when they expire or deal the killing blow[/i]

Concocted Bottles
[i]Poison Darts do not pierce. Poison Darts are thrown around the caster, and explode on contact with an enemy.[/i]

[b]Blizzard[/b]

Temperature Delta
[i]Deal 50% more damage to chilled enemies[/i]

Rushed Strategy
[i]Chills inflicted on enemies have a reversed effect[/i]

[b]Arc[/b]

Charged Field
[i]Nearby enemies take 75% more damage[/i]

Conductive Foes
[i]Arc can no longer hit multiple enemies, but instead always hits the same enemy with every projectile. Arc hits three times as often[/i]

[b]Shotgun[/b]

Intimidating
[i]Shotgun has a 10% chance to inflict Vulnerable for 4s on hit. Vulnerable enemies take 150% more damage[/i]

Golem Blood
[i]Increases all life recovery by 50%[/i]

[b]Lava Orb[/b]

Splitting Magma
[i]Each time a lava orb pierces or chains, it splits in two and each new orb deals 25% less damage. This can occur at most twice.[/i]

Homogenous Mixture
[i]Lava orb always fires one projectile, but damage and size is increased by 50% for each projectile[/i]

[b]Plague Clouds[/b]

Toxicologist
[i]75% less damage taken from Damage over Time[/i]

Plague Runner
[i]+40 Movement Speed for 2 seconds when you are hit[/i]

[b]Black Powder[/b]

Kinetic Projectiles
[i]Projectiles deal 30% more damage. Projectiles always travel at their base speed[/i]

Vampiric Bolts
[i]+1 health recovered per enemy hit by projectiles.[/i]

[b]Amplifier[/b]

Raging Momentum
[i]Deal 20% more damage if you’ve killed in the past 5 seconds[/i]

Precision Strikes
[i]Deal 50% more damage to enemies inflicted with Vulnerable[/i]

[b]Swiftness Boots[/b]

Adrenaline
[i]Gain 15 movement speed for 5 seconds when hit[/i]

Endurance
[i]Gain 30% more armor if you’ve been hit in the past 5 seconds[/i]

[b]Wand of Growth[/b]

Cyclic Destruction
[i]Every 5 seconds, switch between dealing 20% more damage, and having 100% more Area of Effect[/i]

Growing Pain
[i]20% more Area of Effect if you’ve killed in the past 5 seconds[/i]

[b]Jar of Sand[/b]

Time Warp
[i]Damage over Time deals damage 40% faster[/i]

Buff Addict
[i]Effects from pickups last 50% longer[/i]

[b]Mirror[/b]

Piercing Truth
[i]Fire 50% less projectiles, skills pierce twice as many enemies[/i]

Chain Gang
[i]Skills chain instead of pierce[/i]

[b]Oak Shield[/b]

Spiked Carapace
[i]Deal 50% more damage if you’ve been hit in the past 5 seconds[/i]

Deflecting Armor
[i]20% chance to avoid all damage from hits[/i]

[b]Focused Strikes[/b]

Way of the Ranger
[i]Skills fire 2 more projectiles[/i]

Way of the Magus
[i]Skills have 100% more Area of Effect[/i]

[b]Lover’s Ring[/b]

Glass Cannon
[i]50% less Maximum Life, 15% more Cast Speed, 50% more Damage[/i]

Repeater
[i]Skills have 50% more Cast Speed. Skills have 50% less Duration[/i]

[b]Salamander[/b]

Vampiric Skin
[i]100% more Health Regeneration if you’ve taken damage in the past 5 seconds[/i]

Crocodile Skin
[i]Take 90% less damage if you have not been hit in the past 5 seconds.[/i]

[b]Beef Shank[/b]

Hardened Flesh
[i]Take 30% less damage if you have been hit in the past 5 seconds.[/i]

Regenerative Flesh
[i]Every 10 seconds, gain +50 Health Regeneration for 5 seconds.[/i]


Future updates will include improvements to the existing levels, as well as some new additions, and a large increase in monster diversity, as well as monster abilities, and bosses. I’m making sure I get the core systems solid before doing a content pass.

Hope you enjoy the new patch!

Cheers,
zediven
